headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, who took the game 5-9. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Zack Littell earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 9-3 victory, while the Boston Red Sox secured a 9-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Conine, who has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Andrew Nardi, Josh Ekness, Konnor Griffin, Bailey Ober, Angel Zerpa, Craig Kimbrel, and Harrison Bader.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays. The Washington Nationals also made a trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist from the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Padres 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Zack Littell earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run, 2 RBI, and 1 hit in 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Twins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 9-3 victory. Brooks Lee led the Twins' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Guardians 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 9-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jovani Morán earning the win. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with a home run, 1 RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Griffin Conine Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins left fielder Griffin Conine has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
